name: Merge Policy Registry
description: Register merge policies per data type: LWW for simple values, CRDT for counters and sets, OT for text, manual for structured data.
purpose: Provide a typed merge policy registry that maps each data type to its correct merge strategy, enabling extensibility without coupling merge logic to individual data types.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge policy registry is implemented as a typed registry mapping data types to merge strategies.
Built-in policies: LWW for simple values, CRDT for counters and state-based sets, OT for text, manual for structured data.
Policies can be registered and overridden at runtime.
A default policy (LWW) applies when no specific policy is registered.
Policies are tested with concurrent edit scenarios for their target data types.
